reason: B builds on service-relevant Cr coatings and proposes a testable microstructural intervention against an appropriate columnar-Cr baseline; suppressing continuous through-thickness grain-boundary paths is physically plausible and EBSD plus steam-oxidation testing can decisively evaluate it. Its citations do not directly establish the equiaxed-grain mechanism and irradiation testing is underspecified, but A is less grounded and does not adequately address the likely cracking, phase evolution, and adhesion limitations of sub-micron ALD alumina at 1000–1200 °C.
